To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Maine Freedom of Access Act, I hereby request the following records:

- Email and email attachments between Senator Trey Stewart (President of the Senate), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Representative Reagan Paul (House District 37), or any member of their legislative staff, and any representative of the State Legislators Israel Caucus, including any email address ending in @statelegislatorisraelcaucus.com, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Trey Stewart (President of the Senate), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Representative Reagan Paul (House District 37), or any member of their legislative staff, and any official, employee, or agent of the Government of Israel or of the Embassy of Israel to the United States, including any email address ending in @gov.il, regarding the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" delegation, or the "50 States, One Nation" conference held in Israel in September 2025, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Calendar entries, meeting invitations, and scheduling records for Senator Trey Stewart (President of the Senate); Representative Reagan Paul (House District 37) concerning the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" / "50 States, One Nation" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Records of travel, lodging, or expenses paid for, reimbursed to, or arranged for Senator Trey Stewart (President of the Senate); Representative Reagan Paul (House District 37) in connection with the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request, including reimbursement forms, expense reports, and travel or gift disclosures.

- Records identifying the source of funding for the participation of Senator Trey Stewart (President of the Senate); Representative Reagan Paul (House District 37) in the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by 1 M.R.S.A. § 408(6). The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
